hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 swap curve between ETH and phiETH (a 1:1 ETH-backed wrapper token) by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap, taking the input from the PoolManager, converting via phiETH deposit/withdraw, and settling the output. Liquidity addition is blocked entirely; the pool is restricted to ETH/phiETH pairs with zero fee.
